evidence_quotes:
HYDRO-BOOST - Converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the
master cylinder, providing power assist during braking.
statements.reason: The service brake description states this function directly.
statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit converts hydraulic power from the steering pump to mechanical power to the master cylinder.

statements.statement: The hydro-boost unit provides power assist during braking.
